text: ‘Globalisation is a positive development that brings benefits to all social groups.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
OR
‘Transnational organisations have helped to reduce global inequalities.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Research evidence suggests that the media has little impact on behaviour.’ Evaluate this view.
OR
‘Media representations of men and women are largely based on gender stereotypes.’ Evaluate
this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion is a form of ruling class ideology.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The growth of religious fundamentalism is a reaction to the spread of western culture.’ Evaluate
this view. [35]
